name: The Elect Lady (2 John)
title: Recipient of the Apostle's Letter
summary: The Elect Lady is the recipient of John's second letter, likely a prominent Christian woman or a church personified as a woman. She is praised for her faith and her children walking in truth, and warned against false teachers who deny Christ coming in the flesh.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from the Apostle
keyEvents.description: John greets the Elect Lady and her children, whom he loves in truth, along with all who have come to know the truth.

keyEvents.title: Joy Over the Children's Faith
keyEvents.description: The apostle expresses great joy that he has found some of her children walking in truth, just as the Father commanded.

keyEvents.title: Exhortation on Love
keyEvents.description: John exhorts her to hold fast to the commandment of love they have had from the beginning—that they should love one another.

keyEvents.title: Warning Against False Teachers
keyEvents.description: She is warned against many deceivers who do not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh, and against receiving such people into their homes.

keyEvents.title: Greeting from the Sister
keyEvents.description: The letter concludes with greetings from the children of her chosen sister, possibly another church or Christian woman.
